items.text: Colts downgraded WR Keenan Allen to OUT (groin) for London game vs Commanders. Elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine. Boosts Josh Downs/Tyler Warren.
items.implication: Downs becomes clear WR1 for Colts; Warren more targets.

items.text: Justin Jefferson listed OUT for Sunday. Corroborated across sources; creates major opportunity for Jordan Addison in home matchup vs borderline secondary.
items.why: Ankle injury; final designation OUT per ETR Sunday list and team report.
items.implication: Start Addison with confidence; Jefferson owners must pivot.
items.opportunity: Addison target share spike, home vs soft secondary.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday return (hip). Schefter notes expected to play; Levitan flags possible snap limits but positive overall.
items.why: Hip injury cleared; no designation, expected to play vs Eagles.
items.implication: Immediate WR1 upgrade; monitor for any early exit or limits.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected but watch snap count.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL per reports). Listed OUT by ETR alongside Caleb Douglas.
items.implication: Long-term loss; immediate Miami RB committee scramble.

items.text: Breece Hall among players OUT for Sunday (thigh). Also listed by ETR. Jets backfield impacted; Braelon Allen saw 100% snaps after exit last week.
items.implication: Pivot to Jets RBs or sit Hall.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) for Sunday vs Rams. Also OUT: Dallas Goedert and Zack Baun. Eagles offense significantly depleted.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith; confirmed OUT designations.
items.implication: Downgrade Eagles pass catchers and Hurts slightly; look to remaining options or opposing Rams.
items.opportunity: Increased roles for other Eagles WRs/TEs if any healthy; Rams defense benefits.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out. Clear opportunity upgrade.
items.why: Jefferson OUT opens targets; favorable secondary matchup.
items.implication: Strong start/sit upgrade for Addison this week.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share, routes in positive game script potential.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse: without three of most important players vs Rams — DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun. Offense compromised.
items.implication: Fade Eagles skill players/Hurts relative to prior expectations; boost Rams side.
items.opportunity: Reduced for remaining Eagles; opposing defense/run game benefits.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass work to Holani, back-to-back fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet back at practice. Still passes eye test longer-term but OUT this week and role eroded.
items.why: Chest injury + practice return of Charbonnet + usage losses.
items.implication: Avoid/sit; handcuff or committee concerns even when healthy.
items.opportunity: Reduced for Price; potential for others in SEA backfield.

items.text: Nico Collins good to go / ACTIVE (hamstring) vs Cowboys. Excellent DvP spot per Levitan; Texans implied high points.
items.why: Hamstring cleared; official report good to go.
items.implication: Strong WR1 play in favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Elite target share vs soft Cowboys secondary (DvP +7.3% WR scoring).

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches, Dowdle out again. Workhorse vs Browns allowing 88+ rush yds every game.
items.why: Elite snap/touch share with teammate out; strong matchup.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: RB5 utilization last week with 26 touches (more than W1+W2 combined), double-digit target share every game. Giants allow 5.1 YPC (3rd-most).
items.opportunity: High touches + targets in favorable spot.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194). NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Elite chemistry/volume with Penix + soft matchup.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: Low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42% W3, only 13% third downs. SEA allows just 2.9 YPC.
